description: Uploads a PNG, JPEG or WebP image attached in ChatGPT to the connected Magic Hour account. Use this for native ChatGPT photo attachments instead of asking the chat's file runtime to PUT bytes to get_upload_urls. Pass the returned file_path to the existing image or video generation tool. Accepts one image up to 20 MiB. Does not generate media or spend generation credits.

image.description: The native attached image. ChatGPT supplies download_url and file_id; direct MCP callers must supply that file object, not a bare file ID, filename or local path.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS download URL supplied for the native ChatGPT attachment, including its signed query.

file_id.description: Native ChatGPT file identifier paired with download_url; not a local filesystem path.

file_name.description: Original attachment filename, when supplied by ChatGPT.

mime_type.description: Attachment MIME type, when supplied by ChatGPT.

name: upload_chatgpt_image
title: Upload attached image
